BiblicalUsage: Nagah means to glitter or shine, and to give light, and it is used for the lamp of the Lord and the light of the world. In 2 Samuel 22:29 David says, thou art my lamp, O Lord, and the Lord will lighten my darkness, and in Isaiah 9:2 the people that walked in darkness have seen a great light, and upon them hath the light shined.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that light in the Bible is always a gift before it is a command; the lamp is the Lord's, the shining is His, and the people walking in darkness did not light it themselves.
